title: Dusty Dancer
html:
Quest Giver: Jerry the Dusty Dancer

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Teach the Oroks in Balzack's Burrow the new dance move.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Jerry the Dusty Dancer

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Horizontal Line-Dancing

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Teach the Oroks in Balzack's Burrow the new dance move.

Offer:

Ring around the Dungeon, pocket full of Loot, Ashes Ashes the mage burns them all down! Hmm.. that just doesn't flow right. I am going to have to work on it more.

Oh, Goodness, Don't sneak up on an old man like that, you might just make me jump so high I break my hip. Well since you are here I may as well introduce myself. I am Jerry the Dusty Dancer, I used to be Jerry the Most Amazing Dance Instuctor, but that was years ago. Now I have to just take random jobs like this one where I was hired to teach these dumb hobo-monsters how to dance.

Back in the day I was the hot stuff at monster dance camp, that is until that Johnny guy came along. After all these years I have developed the best dance move ever created, but since I am so old these hobo-monsters won't let me teach it to them. Why don't I show you how to perform the move 'Drop to the Ground and Don't Get Up', then you can teach it to them.

When you have finished teaching the dance move come back to me Jerry the Dusty Dancer at the entrance of Balzack's Burrow Level 3.

Turn-in:

I hear the sounds of monsters dropping all around, dropping to the ground, making noises like 'SPLAT!' You must have been a good teacher. Here have this token of the King's wealth or something, I have no use for it here.

Objectives:

  • Teach the Oroks the new dance move.

Client level range: 56–100
